title: Lyra Mobile
shortDescription: Story, characters, panel layouts, and AI manga generation in one workflow.
fullDescription:
Lyra Mobile is a focused manga creation editor for organizing stories, characters, chapters, episodes, scenes, pages, panels, and dialogue in one workflow.

It connects to the same workspace as Lyra on the web and keeps personal and organization work clearly separated. Review inputs before generation, choose character references, follow job progress, refine page layouts, and save generated page images from your phone.

AI suggestions remain editable and destructive changes require explicit confirmation.
